data.one_liner: Configure and provide fake HTTP responses to the dio HTTP client for testing.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to configure fake HTTP responses for Dio based on HTTP methods and URI templates. It includes a custom HttpClientAdapter to route Dio requests through the configured fakes without using traditional mocking frameworks.
use_when: You are writing tests for code that interacts with HTTP services via Dio.
You want to avoid complex mocking libraries for testing network requests.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dio HTTP client.
You need a full-fledged backend server mock over actual sockets rather than an HTTP client adapter.
strengths: Makes testing Dio HTTP calls straightforward and readable.
Supports URI templates and custom request matching logic.
weaknesses: Limited specifically to the Dio HTTP client.
Not documented to support complex mock server scenarios beyond adapter-level faking.
data.setup_notes: Add charlatan to dev_dependencies in pubspec.yaml.
